company_notes:
Opportunity from a Tier-1 defence contractor supporting national grid control centers. Heavy focus on a fully air-gapped Private deployment; no external model calls allowed. Customer insists on HSM-backed key management (FIPS 140-2) and IL5-equivalent enclave for model weights and prompts.

Notes from discovery:
- 2026-02-18: Intro call (Leah, Connor) with CTO + Head of Cyber. CTO: "no sunlit egress; anything external has to be staged and fingerprinted."
- 2026-02-25: Security deep-dive with their InfoSec team. They requested detailed network diagram + installer checklist.
- 2026-03-02: Onsite architecture walk-through (firewall team, SOC). Confirmed available isolated racks and KVM access.

Customer quote: "We need predictable inference in the classified lane — latency under 200ms for operator chat is a must, and an auditable trail for every prompt."

Shorthand/concise: POC = 6-week air-gapped install -> model onboarding (quantized LLM preferred) -> red-team QA -> ATO. Must avoid any third-party telemetry egress.
